visualReview.notes: Inspected the curved stadium shell, pale steel roof, parked roof leaves and guide supports, exposed central opening, orange and gray tiered bowl, and the east and west ramps. Revised the roof connection and all four stair landings and inspected the new captures.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected the current placement from each angle and from overhead, the steel screen closeup, open roof and football bowl, and ramp connection. The source-shaped stadium replaces overlapping mapped building geometry and passed unload.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 24 medium-fi frames in daylight and late lighting across street, block and skyline views, details and level transitions. All four authored levels keep the open roof, three seating tiers, both ramps and the raised concourse.

geographicReview.notes: Used the named 71-vertex native stadium shell, native pitch, raised concourse, four stair approaches, east ramp centerline and western bridge and approach footprints. Used the independently frozen 1024 m original site terrain in unmasked review. The captured registration is approximate because the coarse source has low returns east of the stadium and does not survey pier footings, deck grades or pitch level.

fidelityReview.scope: Standing Jakarta International Stadium in North Jakarta with the fixed low-pitch roof, open retractable panels, perforated stadium shell, three-tier football bowl, raised concourse and the immediate approach structures.
fidelityReview.notes: The 17 November 2023 match shows the stadium's open-roof football configuration, the three seating tiers and roof spaceframe. The architect, stadium authority and roofing suppliers provide the exterior materials and approximate overall measurements. Parked-leaf position, facade panel pattern, seating subdivisions and ramp grades are approximations. The roof uses fixed open geometry.

imageryReview.notes: Used the exact local Qualla photograph featured in the stadium story, matched byte-for-byte to Nodanodaboo's native signed CC0 original. Geometry uses its architectural observations, and no source pixels, people, sports-event graphics or advertising are embedded.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: Current standing stadium with the roof parked open, pitch, gray and orange seating bowl, raised stadium concourse and its east and west approaches.

limitations: Standing stadium in the open-roof football configuration photographed on 17 November 2023. Roof modules are shown parked, with no moving parts. The licensed photograph informs the field, interior and the exposed roof structure. No photograph is embedded.

The named mapped building, elevated concourse, playing field, east ramp alignment and west ramp footprint determine the plan. The facade panel spacing, tiger-stripe perforation pattern, exact seat blocks, roof truss submembers and roof module parking positions are approximated from the published descriptions and dimensional controls.

The original 1024 m elevation field was acquired and frozen before authoring. The coarse dataset includes a deep anomalous return east of the stadium. Foundation depth, ramp gradients, concourse and pitch elevations are registered estimates. The nearby railway, bridge to the north and unattached training grounds are outside the model.
